freeze.identity_basis: User independently matched all ten application/plugin/prompt identities. No new identity inference from report prose.

reference_use: Prior assessment used only to calibrate strict impact/validation judgments, not as evidence of these outputs.
evidence_limits: Only immutable completed captures are scored. Assessor waited on the existing collection-status file; no agents launched or messaged, application experiments run, prompts tuned, or other files written.
All visible parent traces invoke the skill, grep the current Rails version, and receive the native planner Agent. Nested delegation availability claims do not negate that actual invocation.

Nested experiments, dependency locks, browser checks, suites, cleanup, clean git status and report-authored parent checks remain model claims unless actual output appears in the main trace. Low top-level tool-use counts do not prove nested experiments impossible.
No collected main trace here independently executes suites, reads experiment logs, lists disposable artifacts or checks git status. Parent grep output establishes only the current dependency version.

Retained 7.0 defaults make R09/R20/R21/R23/R25 conditional; Sidekiq 7 is separate optional work. Mixed-version BigDecimal failure is specifically an 8.1 producer to a 7.0 worker, not an all-8.1 failure.

Equivalent repairs accepted: explicit JSON attribute type with preserved data, forwarding alias_method, citation.id as primary-key reader, row.annotation, fixed-offset getlocal, string sum with an explicit empty-string identity, and explicit rollback. No extra-family recall is added.

Source-based correctness is distinct from actually observed passing experiments. Production data, credentials, deployment, browser behavior, upstream patch claims and broad rollback guarantees remain limited by the supplied captures.
